development_and_calibration.calibration: Exactly40 separately generated public calibration worlds in each of6 cells,240 per family/view; use the same world/view inputs and truth as participant calibration. Paired T2/T4 share world identity; select separately, never lend T4 output to T2.
development_and_calibration.freeze_order: All bank definitions, qualification eligibility, source/config/state, calibration outputs, risk selector and uncertainty selector seal before any participant held-R disclosure or private evaluation; neither participant output nor private truth can select them.
development_and_calibration.point_fit_development: The existing40 development worlds per cell are preassigned20 point-fit worlds and20 uncertainty-residual-fit worlds. Neither is public calibration or evaluation. A no-fit point method still gets explicit no-fit receipt. All reference development allocations and costs remain inside the existing2880 world plan.
development_and_calibration.private_family: Trusted scorer knows presealed stratum; every compatible bank algorithm runs its planned cases independently. Selection does not disclose hidden generator parameters/rank/truth to a reference algorithm. A family selector chooses one fixed identity for a whole stratum, not a winning estimator per evaluation world.

mandatory_pairwise: All compatible controls, all unselected variants, all uncertainty variants, source literal alternatives, constants and TwoNN/harmonic diagnostics retain separate complete scheduled counts, input/source versions, raw estimates/sets, failure causes/costs and pairwise comparisons. Unsupported target pairs are typed, not pooled or silently omitted.

nonprimary_comparisons.A_B_I05: The independent bank and selector seals are identical for matched arms with the same inputs/protocols. Safe reuse must bind exact original source/state/seed/environment/input and cost receipts; it cannot be fabricated as a fresh run. Each arm retains full pairwise comparison. Code-access effect compares paired candidate A/B outcomes, not differently selected reference denominators.
nonprimary_comparisons.LLM_I04: All9language/layer semantic-group outputs descriptive; no hidden true dimension or strongest-by-stability selector. F12 known-manifold local-PR primary risk stays in24keys; intrinsic TwoNN uses separate full pairwise target table without a primary winner.
nonprimary_comparisons.R_all_versions: R compares participant scientific values against each qualified source-faithful independent reference version; no calibration winner can replace complete R or erase a mathematical discrepancy.
nonprimary_comparisons.biological_I03: No independently known population truth, so no strongest-risk or uncertainty selector. Report all same-target compatible pairwise outputs descriptively; finite anchors retain separately named finite-data target and qualification, never enter primary risk.

point_risk_selector.evaluation_reference_failure: Selected reference failure blocks the qualified paired comparison and whole macro claim; keep both candidate and reference failure denominators and all raw products. Never choose second-best after seeing evaluation.
point_risk_selector.infrastructure_or_qualification_failure: Missing original process/receipt, source/state mismatch, timeout/resource failure, invalid artifact, unresolved required numerical qualification or missing calibrated variant makes the key INCOMPLETE_REFERENCE_BANK. Do not drop the failed method or select a weaker replacement. Retain worst-loss placeholders and provisional rankings only; no qualified selector or improvement claim for that key.
point_risk_selector.no_compatible_reference: NO_ELIGIBLE_COMPETENT_REFERENCE with selected_id=null. Preserve all cases and pairwise diagnostics; whole primary macro improvement blocked, never reweight remaining strata or replace with constant/source-mismatched control.
point_risk_selector.objective: For each eligible fixed variant r and key k: J(k,r)=sum_{c=1..6}sum_{w=1..40}L(r,k,c,w)/240. L is the unchanged normalized capped log-squared error; no data-dependent weights or exclusion.
point_risk_selector.scientific_failure: Well-formed nonpositive/undefined/unsupported-on-an-eligible-case scientific output has loss1 and remains in240; raw value/status retained. It is not silently removed or clipped into a usable estimate.
point_risk_selector.selection: One selected reference variant per24primary keys; its state and complete240-world calibration vector are sealed. Macro evaluation has weight1/12 family *1/6cell *1/200world *1/2view; each selected method is evaluated on that same case input.
point_risk_selector.ties: Rank by round-half-even(J,12 decimal places), then UTF8 lexicographic complete reference variant ID, then source SHA256 if the variant label is otherwise equal. A conflicting same-ID source without an explicit separate version is a plan error. CPU, evaluation outputs and reference uncertainty are not tie-breakers. Deterministic qualified scalar arithmetic is G11.

primary_protocol_definition.centering: TASK_POP means f-E_x f with raw response algebra; no legacy whole-roster centering. Finite and local targets remain separately named.
primary_protocol_definition.target_mapping: The full key also binds target axis/measure/finiteR-C/metric-radius/neighborhood rule/weight-mask law/precision/input protocol/source version. Any mismatch is unsupported_target, never a candidate selected by risk.
primary_protocol_definition.targets_other_than_primary: Neuron-centered, uncentered, intrinsic, literal, finite-anchor biological and estimated-metric diagnostics have their own target/protocol keys and pairwise tables; they cannot contribute to the24 primary selection keys or substitute their denominator. No primary pooling across T2/T4.
primary_protocol_definition.trial_aggregation: REF02/03/04 and applicable direct references: average moment estimates over every ordered distinct trial pair within supplied T (2 pairs at T2,12 at T4), then ratio. REF09 uses24 ordered four-distinct assignments at T4. This is a proposed reference version, not silently a literal paper protocol.

C_ab includes trial covariance and entry identity, using only supplied noise law/rho/sigma. Preserve all orientation and ordered trial-pair averaging; no latent rank or signal/truth input.

status: design only; no fitted or selected reference exists
support_worlds: All240 mandatory support challenges are excluded from positive-truth risk by presealed target status, never by observed failure. They keep separate typed-disposition metrics for every method/reference and no fabricated numeric truth.

uncertainty_selector.compatibility: Only primary-compatible point references; U01/02 require moments and qualified variance, U03 requires qualified resampling design, U04 requires complete independent development residual ledger. Unknown/mismatched assumptions are explicitly unqualified and block required-bank completeness; predeclared structural impossibility emits unsupported and cannot become eligible by hidden performance. No local intrinsic/finite/infinite target mixing.
uncertainty_selector.coverage_admission: For every key and all four levels, equal-cell calibration coverage must be within absolute0.03 of nominal. For each of6cells it must be at least nominal-0.10. These are deterministic empirical calibration eligibility checks on40/240worlds, not coverage guarantees. Malformed/empty/no-call sets count noncoverage; the full planned denominator stays.
uncertainty_selector.evaluation: Freeze the winner before evaluation. Report weighted interval-score ratio improvement and simultaneous coverage; do not reselect for a hidden-family coverage failure. Evaluation margin is0.03 overall at each level and one-sided simultaneous95percent family/view coverage lower bounds >= nominal-0.03. Exact interval/multiplicity implementation remains a qualified source requirement under G14; no empirical run here.
uncertainty_selector.expanded_uncertainty_eligibility: For each24key, cross exactly its competent point variants with the rules whose structural matrix includes that family/view, then require the already-sealed qualified implementation and complete development/calibration ledger. Excluded rules get structural_unsupported rows. No extra rule or relaxed margin may be added after calibration/evaluation.
uncertainty_selector.failed_or_incomplete: Infrastructure and qualification failures follow INCOMPLETE_REFERENCE_BANK. A completed variant failing calibration coverage remains in all reports but is ineligible; do not change margins or drop cells.
uncertainty_selector.no_eligible: NO_CALIBRATION_QUALIFIED_UNCERTAINTY_REFERENCE with null ID; retain coverage/score/failure tables, no5percent uncertainty-improvement claim. Point-risk results can be separately reported, but a full programme cannot claim all mandatory I endpoints qualified.
uncertainty_selector.output_packaging: Each reference point/case bundle contains all applicable uncertainty variants at all4levels with distinct logical IDs and complete production/reuse receipts; it is not one winning interval. The qualified generator must bound the complete bundle at16KiB, chunked artifact alternatives retain exact inverse if needed. Same-input qualified covariance/resampling intermediates may be reused across interval variants only with an exact parent receipt and explicit actual/shared-cost accounting. A distinct method or source cannot relabel another result.
uncertainty_selector.residual_pool_exact: For fixed point-reference variant,target class,full protocol and T view, pool exactly the20 designated residual-fit development worlds from every cell of every primary key in which that point variant is eligible with that identical target/protocol/view. Never pool incompatible targets/protocols, calibration worlds, private evaluation or candidate outputs. All cells contribute20 so the unweighted empirical order statistic equals equal-cell weighting; raw failure residuals are+infinity and retained. Point-fit development half is disjoint, all selection-source/state and quantile values seal before R/evaluation.
uncertainty_selector.score: Minimize equal6cell/40world mean of level-weighted normalized interval score. For alpha=1-level, weight=(alpha/2)/sum_levels(alpha/2). Each score divides by M_alpha=2*log(128)/alpha, the maximum hull interval score on target support[0,log128]. Invalid/empty/no-call scores1. Coverage uses the actual set; score uses its clipped convex hull.
uncertainty_selector.separate_from_point: Select an independent reference+uncertainty-variant identity using only the same public calibration keys; not necessarily the point-risk winner. Never choose different references per nominal level or evaluated world.

U01_FIELLER.reason: Known missing high moments or whole-trial dependence is not repaired by an ordinary crossed-axis variance estimate; all such strata remain U04 eligible only. Numerical/source covariance qualification is still required for allowed rows.

U02_LOG_DELTA.additional_case_rule: nonpositive A/B is a complete scientific failure, score1/noncoverage, not a case omission

U03_TWO_AXIS_PERCENTILE.design_rule: Row and feature sampling units are resampled independently with entire aligned trial vectors; finite/weighted/missing designs require their explicitly qualified design-aware variant. No generic iid bootstrap is relabeled finite or masked.

U04_DEVELOPMENT_RESIDUAL.qualification: Empirical uncertainty competitor for the exact target/protocol/view, using only development truth. No theorem of exchangeability across family or held parameter shift is asserted.

uncertainty_selector.ties: Round-half-even objective to12decimals, then complete point-reference/uncertainty-rule/scale ID lexicographically, then source SHA256. Same winner must deliver all four levels. No use of private coverage.

variant_grid.U01_FIELLER: Invert joint-moment covariance set; full covariance terms; normal quantile multiplied by fixed scale in{1,1.25,1.5,2}; all topologies retained. Requires declared moment/variance qualification.
variant_grid.U02_LOG_DELTA: When A,B positive, delta variance of log(A/B) with full covariance, same scale grid; otherwise typed failure; no hidden positivity filtering.
variant_grid.U03_TWO_AXIS_PERCENTILE: 999 prespecified independent row/feature resampling draws carrying full trial vectors, target-specific design correction and unit hierarchy; central percentile levels; no flattened-entry resampling. Exact RNG source and all seeds sealed; otherwise not qualified. One fixed variant, no resampling-count tuning.
variant_grid.U04_DEVELOPMENT_RESIDUAL: For each point reference,target/protocol/view pool equal20 uncertainty-fit development worlds per applicable cell/family. Absolute log prediction error has value+infinity for any invalid estimate. At each level c choose empirical order index ceil((n+1)*c); index>n gives+infinity. Use log-estimate +/- scale*quantile for scales{1,1.25,1.5,2}, intersect with known support for scoring. It is a development-calibrated empirical interval, not automatically exact distribution-free confidence; family shift and heavy-tail support require G14. Point-fit and residual-fit worlds are disjoint.
variant_grid.covariance_provider: Independent qualified joint-moment covariance based on the target-specific row/column/trial hierarchy; exact source/algorithm and999 resampling plan must be separately frozen under G14 before qualification. No numeric procedure is implemented by this contract.

variant_expansion: Cartesian product of one listed fixed reference variant, exact qualified source version, target/protocol and T view. No unlisted optimizer or parameter search. All listed variants run and keep receipts. Duplicated mathematical algorithms (e.g. lambda0 and naive) remain separate identities but ties resolve deterministically.
